name: F/A-18 HORNET
blurb: The mount itself — carrier-capable strike fighter, gear up, ready for the cat.

name: F-14 TOMCAT
blurb: VF-84 Jolly Rogers, 1978. Swing-wing fleet defender with four Phoenix in the tunnel — printed wings spread, skull and crossbones on both tails.

name: F-16 FIGHTING FALCON
blurb: The land-based hot-rod. No tailhook — the boat said no.

name: MIG-29 FULCRUM
blurb: The bogey of choice over the Bay. Twin tails, red stars, bad intentions.

name: AIR FORCE ONE (VC-25A)
blurb: The 1994 presidential 747-200B. Mind the paint. She has an escort for a reason.

name: ALLIED AIRLINES 747-400
blurb: 388 souls aboard. The Queen of the SFO heavies — check your fire.

name: LIBERTY AIR 737-400
blurb: Polished-silver shuttle, 146 souls. The Bay commuter.

name: PACIFIC EMPRESS DC-10
blurb: Trijet heavy, 268 souls. The defector flew one of these in.

name: CASCADE AIR MD-90
blurb: T-tail Mad Dog with rear twins, 158 souls.

name: BOEING 707 INTERCONTINENTAL
blurb: The classic long-hauler — still working the ident runs out of SFO.

name: CRUISE MISSILE
blurb: The Moffett bandit — low, fast, and not here to sightsee. Prints in one piece.

name: P-3 ORION
blurb: The sub hunter — four turboprops, MAD boom out, 500 feet over the sea lanes.

name: SH-60 SEAHAWK
blurb: The cruiser's rotor — prints on its wheels with the main rotor spread.

name: E-2C HAWKEYE
blurb: VAW-123 Screwtops — quad tail, four blades a side, and the black corkscrew on the rotodome.

name: AH-64 APACHE
blurb: The Army's attack helicopter — tandem cockpit, chin gun, Hellfires on the stubs. K-MAN's mount.

name: USS ENTERPRISE (CVN-65)
blurb: The Big E — your home plate. Angled deck, island, the works.

name: GUIDED-MISSILE CRUISER
blurb: The picket ahead of the Big E. Turrets fore, helo deck aft.

name: DESTROYER
blurb: Beam escort, port and starboard stations. Greyhound of the group.

name: FRIGATE
blurb: The astern picket, clear of the approach. The small grey roommate.

name: MT PETRO PACIFIC
blurb: 360 m of supertanker — the giant of the lane. Barely answers her helm.

name: MS BAY MONARCH
blurb: The cruise liner — stacked white decks and the fastest hull in the lane.

name: MV BAY TRADER
blurb: Container freighter, lane regular, stacked high.

name: SHADOW SUB
blurb: A submersible aircraft carrier, surfaced. Up to no good in the lane.

name: FISHING BOAT
blurb: The 22 m crabber that works the banks outside the Gate.

name: SAILBOAT
blurb: Weekend sloop, 11 m. Mind your wake.

name: MOTOR CRUISER
blurb: 11 m cabin cruiser — the other half of the weekend traffic.

name: RESCUE RAFT
blurb: Mission 4's customer. Holds one downed pilot; snacks not included.
